title: Apply martian forwarding filter in C
description: At the C forwarding decision, reject policy-invalid IPv6 source/destination addresses before route emission, while preserving byte-preserving RX decode. Cover loopback and IPv4-mapped transit addresses and multicast scopes 2-14 per spec 7.3. Add focused host tests with an independent expected policy table.
close_reason: Implemented C forwarding-plane martian filtering with byte-preserving cursor reads, policy drop counter, and independent scope/address tests. Standalone ASan/UBSan CTest passed. Three Kimi reviewer invocations were unavailable due insufficient OpenRouter credits; completed local correctness, security, and edge-case passes with no findings.
